channel.title: PaddySpeaks — changelog
channel.description: Meaningful changes to PaddySpeaks: new essays of note, sacred texts, Interview Studio, JobSignal, demos, corrections, privacy and platform.

item.title: PaddySpeaks becomes one connected platform
item.description: Five journeys (Read, Learn, Prepare, Find, Build) now organise the site; a single search covers essays, sacred texts down to the verse, Interview Studio, companies and demos; the Atlas shows how they connect; and the homepage can pick up where you left off — from this browser's own history, never a server.

item.title: Sources, corrections and one source of truth for every number
item.description: Every sacred-text app now has a Sources & Verification panel that says honestly where its text came from — including when that is not recorded. A public corrections log lists meaningful fixes. Every public statistic is now derived from the content itself, which corrected the question, data-model and sacred-text counts that had drifted.

item.title: Privacy claims now match the code, and a privacy policy
item.description: Pages whose privacy promises went further than the code — claiming nothing was ever sent while loading analytics — were corrected; the Privacy Console gained a step-by-step data-flow section and dropped its tracking pixel; the analytics server now honours Global Privacy Control for every request. A plain-language privacy policy, terms, disclaimer and copyright page were added.

item.title: API hardening, secret scanning and backups
item.description: The site's API now only answers the site's own pages, compares the admin password in constant time and locks out repeated wrong guesses, meters the privacy scan proxy and re-checks every redirect it follows, and deletes expired leaderboard data daily. CI now scans for committed secrets and audits dependencies.

item.title: Accessibility baseline
item.description: Search is now a proper keyboard- and screen-reader-accessible dialog; every page gets a visible focus ring, a skip link and reduced motion on request; sacred-text search boxes are labelled. An automated WCAG 2.2 check runs on every change and may not get worse.

item.title: JobSignal launches — jobs that still exist
item.description: A job search whose promise is that every role is still live on the employer's own careers page, re-checked every four hours. Reposts are labelled as reposts with their history, never as newly posted, and search keeps to the role you asked for.

item.title: JobSignal: locations corrected
item.description: About 9% of roles showed a place that does not exist. Multi-location postings now list every place, and each city has one spelling.

item.title: Abhirami Andhadhi becomes a layered interpretation
item.description: Seventeen verses gained word-by-word breakdowns, interpretation and cross-links to the Lalitha Sahasranama. Inherited English meanings found to be misaligned are labelled as under review rather than presented as settled.

item.title: New interactive essay: AI Is Looking For You
item.description: A story in nine scenes about how professional discovery is changing when an agent, not a recruiter, reads your profile first.

item.title: Three executive AI & data demos
item.description: The AI Executive Command Center, Revenue Leakage & Margin Intelligence Hub and Enterprise Resilience War Room join the Lakehouse demo — each on clearly labelled synthetic data.

item.title: New essay: The Job Posting Is Not the Job
item.description: A visual field guide to the 2026 hiring market: how to tell whether a role is real, who is behind it, and how to get from 'Apply' to a conversation.

item.title: Can You Really Afford the Bay Area? — published and then corrected
item.description: A modelled look at sixty years of Bay Area housing against income, rebuilt after a source-by-source review; the article carries its own dated corrections note.

item.title: Devotional Music: the keertanas of Bhadrachala Ramadasu
item.description: A new series, one song per article: Telugu text and transliteration, word-by-word meanings, ragam and talam where sources agree (and the disagreement where they do not), and curated listening.

item.title: Interview Studio: Spark debugging & performance track
item.description: A field guide from 'why is my job stuck?' to root cause — then hardened after review, which corrected an inconsistency about Adaptive Query Execution.

item.title: Community question submissions no longer dropped
item.description: Questions filed under a topic the importer did not recognise were being silently skipped; they are now routed and published.

item.title: Privacy Console
item.description: A working tool that finds where your personal information is published, checks each result is really you, and walks the removal through — with your profile kept in your own browser — alongside a local command-line agent.

item.title: Contact and testimonials
item.description: A contact form, and testimonials that are never published automatically: every one is reviewed first, and only approved ones appear.

item.title: Interview Studio: Communication and AI Engineering tracks
item.description: Workplace English and communication practice for interviews and the job, and an AI engineering track from data engineering to LLM-native systems.
